question: Hema Malini, who was appointed Member of Committee on the Empowerment of Women in April 2025, represents which parliamentary constituency?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Mathura**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Hema Malini** is an Indian actress, politician, and former Member of Parliament.
 
• She was elected to the Lok Sabha from the **Mathura parliamentary constituency**, located in the state of **Uttar Pradesh**.
 
• Mathura is famously known as the **birthplace of Lord Krishna** and is a significant cultural and religious site in India.
 
• Hema Malini represents the **Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP)** and has actively participated in matters concerning women’s empowerment.
 
• She was appointed as a Member of the **Committee on the Empowerment of Women** in April 2025, which works towards addressing issues related to gender equality and women’s welfare.
 
• **Uttar Pradesh**, where Mathura is situated, is the most populous state in India and holds substantial political importance.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Bareilly**__

 __
 
• **Bareilly** is located in the state of Uttar Pradesh and is known for its **Bamboo market** and **Zari work.**
 
• The city is often referred to as the **"Nath Nagri"** due to the presence of several Shiva temples.
 
• Bareilly does not hold political relevance for Hema Malini as it is not her constituency.
 
 
 
• **Agra**__
 __
 
• **Agra** is famous for the **Taj Mahal**, one of the Seven Wonders of the World.
 
• It is located in Uttar Pradesh and is an important tourist destination.
 
• Agra is not associated with Hema Malini’s political career as she does not represent this constituency.
 
 
 
• **Meerut**__
 
 
• **Meerut** is a city in Uttar Pradesh known for its **historical significance** during the Indian Rebellion of 1857.
 
• The city is famous for its **sports goods manufacturing industry**.
 
• Hema Malini does not represent Meerut in the Lok Sabha.
